title: D2: data authority model (decided)
description: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-16). Every JMAP data type declares single-author or sequenced. Single-author (chat messages, own RSVP, own task status): each member's client/daemon keeps a replicated JMAP store; changes travel as MLS application messages; no server. Sequenced (shared file trees, task assignment, anything needing one order): a blind sequencer per community stamps order on ENCRYPTED operations; it reads nothing; clients apply in stamped order and run identical validation, rejecting conflicting ops deterministically. Any party the community designates may run it (trusted for availability, not confidentiality); small COs can run it beside the Q1 countersigning service. Offline sequencer = shared edits queue. Per-type CRDTs (e.g. Kleppmann 2021 tree move) MAY be adopted later. Note: every Space has a CO (its owner).
close_reason: Decided by Mark 2026-10-16 and applied in spec (13, 05, 06, 11, 14, profiles of jmap family)
